g.text: Testing at scale: contract, e2e, load and chaos
Unit tests prove a function; they do not prove a distributed system survives production.
Plus what the pyramid usually omits:
Keep them few: cover the money paths
Measure latency & errors vs. the SLO
Find the bottleneck with your traces
Break things on purpose, under control
You designed for failure; now prove it
A payments hiccup takes it all down
Load test up to the SLO
find the knee, fix the bottleneck the trace reveals
saga compensates · circuit breaker protects checkout
Unit tests: table stakes · Resilience: load + failure
Mocking the DB instead of testcontainers
→ you discover your limits in production
The pre-release flow, explained as a restaurant
